description_en: Queries the endpoint groups that are associated with a custom routing listener
description_zh: 调用ListCustomRoutingEndpointGroups接口查询自定义路由类型监听关联的终端节点组
kebab_example: aliyun ga list-custom-routing-endpoint-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCustomRoutingEndpointGroups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GA instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom routing listener
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the access log feature is enabled.

You can set the parameter to on.

If you leave the parameter empty, all endpoint groups are returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启了访问日志。取值：

  on：已开启访问日志。

该参数为空时，不进行筛选，返回所有终端节点组
parameters.name: access_log_switch

EndpointGroups.description_en: The configuration information about the endpoint group

items.description_en: The configuration information about the endpoint groups

AcceleratorId.description_en: The ID of the GA instance

Description.description_en: The description of the endpoint group
Description.description_zh: 终端节点组的描述信息

EndpointGroupId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint group

EndpointGroupIpList.description_zh: 终端节点组出公网IP列表

items.description_zh: 终端节点组出公网IP列表

EndpointGroupRegion.description_en: The ID of the region where the endpoint group is created
EndpointGroupRegion.description_zh: 终端节点组所属的地域ID

EndpointGroupUnconfirmedIpList.description_en: The endpoint group IP addresses to be confirmed after the GA instance is upgraded
EndpointGroupUnconfirmedIpList.description_zh: 全球加速实例升级后新增待确认的终端节点组IP列表

items.description_en: The endpoint group IP address to be confirmed after the GA instance is upgraded
items.description_zh: 全球加速实例升级后新增待确认的终端节点组IP列表

ListenerId.description_en: The ID of the custom routing listener

Name.description_en: The name of the endpoint group

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service that manages the instance.

This parameter takes effect only if ServiceManaged is set to True
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the GA instance is managed. Valid values:

true
false
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：
true：是托管实例。
false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The actions that users can perform on the managed instance.



This parameter takes effect only if ServiceManaged is set to True.

Users can perform only specific actions on a managed instance
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_en: A list of action policies that users can execute on this managed instance
items.description_zh: 用户可在该托管实例执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the action on the managed instance. Valid values:

Create
Update
Delete
Associate
UserUnmanaged
CreateChild
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称，取值：
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The type of the child resource. Valid values:

Listener: listener
IpSet: acceleration region
EndpointGroup: endpoint group
ForwardingRule: forwarding rule
Endpoint: endpoint
EndpointGroupDestination: protocol mapping of an endpoint group associated with a custom routing listener
EndpointPolicy: traffic policy of an endpoint associated with a custom routing listener

This parameter takes effect only if Action is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型，取值：

Listener：监听资源。

IpSet：加速地域资源。

EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。

ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。

Endpoint：终端节点资源。

EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。

EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。

仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the specified actions are managed.

true: Users cannot perform the specified actions on the managed instance.
false: Users can perform the specified actions on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：

true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。

false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

State.description_en:
The status of the endpoint group. Valid values:

init
active
updating
deleting
State.description_zh:
终端节点组的状态。
init：初始化。
active：正常。
updating：更新中。
deleting：删除中

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数
